title: Plumeform comparison table (v2)
description: A calm comparison table on paper: an eyebrow (and optionally a heavy heading), then a 28px near-white card with a pale header row of small spaced capitals, hairline rows, bold first column, and one row inverted to solid ink with a mint marker beside its name. A small footnote and an optional line of underlined links follow. It scrolls sideways inside its card on narrow screens.
notes: mark your own row with highlight: true; its tag shows next to the name
